in_marathi.name: Nandhu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nandhu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘nand’, meaning ‘joy’ or ‘bliss’. In Hindu mythology, Lord Indra is also known as Nandaka, the giver of joy, and Lord Vishnu is sometimes referred to as Nanda, the one who gives pleasure. The name Nandhu is a beautiful reminder of the inner joy and happiness that each of us carries within ourselves.
